name: fly-dock
description: An open-source Windows dock inspired by RocketDock: widgets, themes and icon packs.
author: Fatih Erdem

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run helper:build && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:unpack: npm run typecheck && npm run helper:build && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
scripts.test: node tests/packs.test.mjs && node tests/physics.test.mjs && node tests/tweaks.test.mjs && node tests/textures.test.mjs && node tests/toys.test.mjs && node tests/cursors.test.mjs && node tests/penalty.test.mjs && node tests/minigames.test.mjs
